dedupe_keys.name: cims climate and energy economic model

description: CIMS is a Python implementation of the Canadian Integrated Modelling System climate-economy model, maintained by Simon Fraser University's Energy and Materials Research Group. Its public guide describes running policy and technology scenarios from a local environment. Users supply energy-service demands, technology costs, policy settings and scenario years; outputs are projected technology choices, energy use or emissions under the selected assumptions. Geographic coverage is case-dependent, historically Canadian in the related CIMS model family. MIT source and a getting-started guide are public, although the Python package is not yet on PyPI. A limitation is that forecasted behaviour depends on calibrated technology and behavioural parameters; source availability does not validate a particular regional case. CIMS can assess transport, building and industry transition effects on energy infrastructure. The similarly named catalogue INL CIMS is a critical-infrastructure system model, a different resource. No case dataset or package was downloaded.
